headline: Premier League live updates: Man United face Bournemouth, Liverpool host Brighton
description: Manchester United boss Michael Carrick dropped captain Bruno Fernandes against Bournemouth but his side fell 2-0 down by half time to pile the pressure on. Will he still be in a job on Monday?

headline: Man City must be 'more clinical,' Enzo Maresca demands
description: Manchester City boss Enzo Maresca says his side needs to be more clinical and "score more goals" after they were beaten by Aston Villa on Saturday.

headline: Arsenal unlocked key to set-piece dominance - Mikel Arteta
description: Mikel Arteta is confident Arsenal will rediscover their potency from set-pieces after breaking their duck in Saturday's 2-0 Premier League victory over Everton.

headline: Bruno Fernandes left out by Man United after Michael Carrick criticism
description: Bruno Fernandes has been left out of the Manchester United team to face Bournemouth after his public criticism of head coach Michael Carrick.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal, Man United, Liverpool track Bayern star Karl
description: Arsenal, Manchester United and Liverpool are monitoring Bayern Munich forward Lennart Karl. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Man City beaten by Jackson's double for Aston Villa
description: Nicolas Jackson nets both goals for Aston Villa to end Manchester City's perfect start to the Premier League season with a 2-1 win at Villa Park.
